name: trust_safety_gaming
use_case: Trust & safety / gaming voice chat: profanity, toxicity, threats, child safety
description: Live game / stream voice chat. Profanity and toxicity spans (insult, hate, threat, sexual, self-harm), utterance-level threat escalation, child-safety (grooming cue, inappropriate), solicitation, scam and PII-leak flags; masks profanity / toxicity / PII in the caption.
_notes: stream_chat is a safety domain: toxicity spans use the 0.3 span-head floor instead of the 0.5 used elsewhere. Child-safety and self-harm flags are low-threshold review triggers (route to a human), not automatic actions.
